description: Procedural approximation of QC71336 black plastic for QC7-5244 black smoke tests. This intentionally avoids transferring QC71336 UV texture maps because they create unrealistic streaks/bumps on QC7-5244.

notes: Slightly cool deep gray base color.
Moderate roughness with weak specular to preserve soft plastic highlights.
Subtle procedural bump only; no image texture transfer.
Use QC7-5244 preset safe zone to avoid slopes, inner grooves, holes, and strong geometry-transition areas.

scene_calibration.note: Current black-dot backend records these scene fields but only material_parameters are used by the material override branch.
